title: Are you a waste of space?
html:
You might know that at a molecular level everything is energy and that even an unmoving rock is actually 99% empty space.

So if someone has ever called you a waste of space, they were half right because you are mostly space. What holds everything together is energy, and luckily, energy is everywhere. In the sun, the rain, wind, food and relationships.

When I googled waste of space I was amazed to find whole websites and forums devoted to people who think they are a waste of space. However, none of us are actually a waste of space. We all offer valuable lessons to everyone around us and contribute more to the world than we are aware of.

So if you're having a waste of space day remember this from E. Knight, "Waste not the smallest thing created, for grains of sand make mountains, and atomies infinity."
